changelog:
Initial release of haohuo-recommend as a user-facing shopping assistant built on haohuo-cps:

- Skill renamed to "haohuo-recommend" and repositioned for end-buyer shopping guidance (not CPS promoters).
- Relies on haohuo-cps for all product data, with clear buyer-focused conversational formatting.
- Removed internal scripts (no direct data fetching); presentation, filtering, and reply style revised for retail buyers.
- Strict filtering: omits CPS terms and commission info from buyer replies, provides only relevant product, price, and offer details.
- Detailed best-practices for how and when to call haohuo-cps, reply structure, and filtering/summarization of results.
- Added instructions for CPS promoters on deployment and integration (not shown to end-users).
summary: 电商导购助手，以对话方式为终端买家提供商品推荐、价格查询、优惠提醒、购物建议。基于 haohuo-cps 获取实时商品数据，链接默认为 CPS 推广链接（推广者可赚取佣金）。适合 CPS 推广者接入到自己的 APP 或购物群，作为买家侧的导购入口
